column3: NASB follows the critical text without “and”; “work” is rendered “deed.”
NASB renders “denigrate” as “malign,” “peaceable” as “uncontentious,” and “humility” as “consideration.”
NASB renders “serving” as “enslaved to” and “living” as “spending our life.”
NASB reorders the verse and renders “the love of mankind” as “His love for mankind.”
NASB follows the critical text; it moves “He saved us” forward and renders “works” as “deeds.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we might be made heirs”); “that grace” is rendered “His grace.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “affirm strongly” as “speak confidently,” “be devoted to” as “engage in,” and “excellent” as “good.”
NASB renders “has been corrupted” as “is perverted.”
NASB renders “be diligent” as “make every effort” and “winter” as “spend the winter.”
NASB renders “equip” as “help … on their way.”
NASB renders “devote themselves to” as “engage in” and “for the necessary needs” as “to meet pressing needs.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Amen” and the Textus Receptus subscription.
